summary: Oruka Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under an existing S-3 shelf, detailing an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $500 million in common stock through agent TD Cowen. The filing describes an ordinary ATM program with a 3.0% commission rate, no escrow, and sales at prevailing market prices. The last reported price on August 20, 2026, was $104.86 per share. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from continued ATM sales and their impact on share price.
